findings.issue: `CommonOverfield`, `commonOverfield`, `comparison`, `map` and their simp lemmas (lines 76-177) are a field-theoretic construction (residue field of a maximal ideal of `K ⊗[k] L`) for the ReductiveGroups descent theorems, dropped into a file documented as the three base-change compatibility equivalences serving central simple algebras and attributed to the semisimple-algebras roadmap Layer 6. summary: Placement is otherwise correct (split-torus lemmas under `SplitTorus/`, descent theorems in the respective `*/BaseChange.lean`, imports all used), but the new `CommonOverfield` block is appended to a file whose declared topic and roadmap attribution are the central-simple/Brauer base-change compatibilities.
